text: On her 50th birthday, the faded Hollywood star Elisabeth Sparkle is [dismissed from her aerobics TV show for her age|origin|a cruel society]. A black market drug promises a younger, more beautiful version of herself, and after one injection [Sue emerges from a slit in her back|threat|the body turning monstrous]. The two must switch every week, but Sue, a sensation as Elisabeth's replacement, [steals extra days|wants|taking someone's place] by [drawing more stabilizer fluid from Elisabeth's body|rules|it must feed], and each delay ages the older woman further.
